summary: The Witness entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Witness
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release on Steam or GOG

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build at documented resolution/settings

primary.why: The PC route has the best capture, resolution, and input flexibility for the open-island puzzle game. Console and mobile ports are useful for platform coverage, but they do not replace the PC route for fidelity-first archive recording.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release through Steam or GOG. Record storefront/build, resolution/HDR/color settings where relevant, input method, puzzle-progress route, audio/language state, and whether any console/mobile ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for platform-specific controls, performance, or display comparison.
secondary.why: PC is the best archive capture route.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 4 / Xbox One / Nintendo Switch / iOS / Android
all_releases.fidelity: Console and mobile ports with platform-specific controls/performance.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC route covers the full game; other ports are mainly platform comparisons.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record platform and display settings because puzzle readability depends heavily on presentation.
